_readme: Eval cases for the coding agent. Each case: fresh checkout of `repo` at `base_commit`, run pi headless with `prompt`, then every assertion `cmd` runs in the checkout (bash, exit 0 = pass). `repo` is an absolute path or a path relative to this repo's root ('.' = zen-coding itself). Real golden-PR cases go here; `smoke-hello` only proves the loop works.

cases.prompt: Create a file named hello_eval.txt at the repository root containing exactly the single line: ok

assertions.desc: hello_eval.txt exists with the expected content
